name: Wave Assist
description: Wave assist: rescues the wave on the last frame before death, with an Assist button in the pause menu.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Assist
assist-enabled.description: Turn the wave assist on or off.

assist-method.name: Method
assist-method.description: Rescue = step back 1 step and flip the click. Rewind = step back several steps and flip.

rewind-steps.name: Rewind Steps
rewind-steps.description: How many physics steps to go back in Rewind method.

max-rescues.name: Max rescues in a row
max-rescues.description: After this many rescues in a row the wave is allowed to die. 0 = unlimited.

miss-chance.name: Miss chance (%)
miss-chance.description: Chance that the assist does not save you, to look more human.

practice-only.name: Only in practice mode
practice-only.description: Use the assist only in practice mode.
